# Completed maintainer-recorded weighted INIT round: 2 SQL observations, 368 hex cells.
# Follow-up to tools/kll/merge_order.answers.txt; findings: tools/kll/weighted_stream.md.
# Archived BigQuery bytes, not golden writer expectations. Do not regenerate.

# Precision 1: a power-of-two input establishes height/cutoff, plus a small weight.
# The big input alone is exact at level 20; candidate cutoff is 20.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, direction, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY w, direction, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, direction, trial,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(item.v, 1, weight => item.weight) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17]) AS w,
       UNNEST(['big_first', 'small_first']) AS direction,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 7)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(IF(direction = 'big_first',
         [STRUCT(42 AS v, 1048576 AS weight), STRUCT(100 AS v, w AS weight)],
         [STRUCT(100 AS v, w AS weight), STRUCT(42 AS v, 1048576 AS weight)]
       )) AS item
  GROUP BY w, direction, trial
)

# Precision 1000: a power-of-two input establishes height/cutoff, plus a small weight.
# The big input alone is exact at level 20; candidate cutoff is 3.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, direction, trial, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY w, direction, trial)
FROM (
  SELECT w, direction, trial,
         KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(item.v, 1000, weight => item.weight) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 23, 24, 25]) AS w,
       UNNEST(['big_first', 'small_first']) AS direction,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 7)) AS trial,
       UNNEST(IF(direction = 'big_first',
         [STRUCT(42 AS v, 1048576 AS weight), STRUCT(100 AS v, w AS weight)],
         [STRUCT(100 AS v, w AS weight), STRUCT(42 AS v, 1048576 AS weight)]
       )) AS item
  GROUP BY w, direction, trial
)
